get.summary: Lists audit entries, newest first, one page at a time.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: Starts at 1.

post.summary: Sends a 6-digit code. Same response for every valid phone, registered or not.
Verifies the code and signs in; the first login of a phone creates its shop and Owner.

Exchanges a refresh token (body, else cookie) for a new pair, answered the same way it
came in. Each refresh token works once; replaying one signs out every session of that login.
Signs out this login on every device that shares it. Always succeeds.

get.summary: The signed-in user, as read from the access token.

One level of a courier's location list, for the booking form: cities (no parentId), the
zones of a city, or the areas of a zone (areas without home delivery are left out). Sorted
by name; cached for a day. All staff. 400 if the courier has no lists, is not connected, or
the parent is unknown; 503 if the courier did not answer.
Couriers Hishab supports, the fields each needs, and which ones this shop has connected. All staff.

put.summary:
Connects a courier, or replaces its keys. The keys are checked with the courier first
(400 if rejected). A new courier counts against the plan (402 on the Free plan's second courier). Owner and Manager (ManageShop).

delete.summary: Disconnects a courier and deletes its keys. Owner and Manager (ManageShop).

get.summary: Lists customers, newest first; search by name or phone digits.

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: Part of a name, or at least 3 digits of a phone number.

post.summary: Returns the customer for this phone, creating it when new (201) or matching it (200; only missing details are filled).

Quick-order auto-fill: finds the customer for a phone (any spelling), with their order
history in this shop. 404 means a new customer. Check isBlocked before taking the order.

get.summary: The customer with their order history in this shop (counts, delivered value and risk badge).

put.summary: Replaces name, address and notes. The phone (the customer's identity) cannot change.

post.summary: Blocks the customer; order entry shows a warning for blocked customers.

get.summary:
Every order matching the order list's filters, newest first, one row per order (items as text).
Streamed: large shops download without the server loading everything first.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: One or more statuses; repeat the parameter for several.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: First day (Asia/Dhaka), inclusive. <example>2026-11-01</example>

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Last day (Asia/Dhaka), inclusive. <example>2026-11-30</example>

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: Order number, part of the customer's name, or 3+ digits of their phone.

get.summary: Every customer matching the customer list's search, newest first, with order counts.

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: Part of a name, or at least 3 digits of a phone number.

get.summary:
How much cash each courier owes the shop: COD expected on delivered parcels, collected
(settled), and outstanding split by age in Dhaka days since delivery.

post.summary:
Records a courier payout from its statement and matches each line to a delivered parcel by
consignment ID. Matched orders become CodSettled (a short or over payment still settles, with the
gap shown); lines that match nothing are kept with the reason. One payout per courier and reference.

get.summary: Recorded payouts, newest paid first.

parameters.name: Courier
parameters.description: Only this courier's payouts.

post.summary:
Matches the payout's UnknownParcel and NotDelivered lines again (e.g. a parcel that was still in
transit when the payout was entered and is delivered now) and settles the orders they now match.
Settled lines and all amounts stay as they are. 409 if an order changed meanwhile (try again).

get.summary: One payout with every statement line and what it matched.

post.summary:
Creates an order in one request. Send a new Idempotency-Key (e.g. a UUID) per order form
submission: retrying with the same key returns the first order instead of creating another.

get.summary:
The shop's orders, newest first. Filters combine with AND. Keyset paging: pass the
returned `nextCursor` to get the next page; it is null on the last page.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: One or more statuses; repeat the parameter for several (status=New, then status=Confirmed).

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: First day (Asia/Dhaka), inclusive.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Last day (Asia/Dhaka), inclusive.

parameters.name: IsInsideDhaka
parameters.description: Area: true for inside Dhaka, false for outside.

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: Order number ("#1043"), part of the customer's name, or 3+ digits of their phone.

parameters.name: CustomerId
parameters.description: Only this customer's orders (the customer page).

parameters.name: Cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page; omit for the first page.

get.summary: The order with its lines, history and the customer's track record.

post.summary: Confirms a New order (the buyer said yes on the phone). 409 if it is not New or changed meanwhile.

Books a Confirmed order with a courier (the shop's default when none is given) and moves it
to Booked. Safe to retry: an already booked order returns its booking, and the courier
always receives the same reference, so it never books the parcel twice. 409 if the order is
not Confirmed; 400 if no courier is connected or the courier refuses the parcel; 503 if the
courier did not answer (retry).

The courier's price for this order (delivery fee and COD charge), to a destination for
couriers that price by location (Pathao needs city and zone). Saves nothing. 400 if a
destination is needed or not in the courier's lists; 503 if the courier did not answer.

get.summary:
Shipping labels for booked orders as one PDF (Bangla supported), in the order given.
400 if an order is not booked yet; 404 if an order is not in this shop; 503 if printing is
unavailable right now.

parameters.name: Ids
parameters.description: Booked orders to print, at most 100; repeat the parameter: `?ids=..&ids=..`.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: A4 sheet (8 per page) or thermal 100 × 150 mm (one per page).

get.summary:
Invoices for the buyer as one PDF, one per page (Bangla supported), in the order given.
Selling prices only, never costs. 400 if an order is cancelled; 404 if an order is not in
this shop; 503 if printing is unavailable right now.

parameters.name: Ids
parameters.description: Orders to print (any status but Cancelled), at most 100; repeat the parameter: `?ids=..&ids=..`.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: A5 (folds into the parcel, default) or A4; one invoice per page.

post.summary: Cancels a New or Confirmed order. 409 once it is booked with a courier or changed meanwhile.

A returned parcel is back at the shop: Returned -> ReceivedBack, optionally with the courier's
return charge (saved together). 403 if a charge is sent by staff who cannot see profit; 409 if
the order is not Returned or changed meanwhile.

put.summary:
Enters or corrects the courier's return charge on a Returned or ReceivedBack order (for
parcels a packer received without it). 409 if the order was not returned.

post.summary:
Confirms many orders. Always 200 with one result per order: check `failed` and each
result's `error`; successful orders stay confirmed even when others fail.

Books many Confirmed orders with one courier (the shop's default when none is given). Always
200 with one result per order: booked orders stay booked when others fail. Failed orders can
be sent again safely (`courierUnavailable` never creates a second parcel). 400 only when
no courier can be used at all.
Cancels many orders, each on its own (see bulk confirm).

get.summary: Searches active products by name or SKU, ordered by name.

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: Part of a product name or SKU, case-insensitive.

delete.summary: Soft delete: the product leaves the catalogue; past orders keep it.

put.summary: Changes a variant. Omit costPrice to keep the current cost.

delete.summary: Soft-deletes a variant. The last active variant cannot be removed (delete the product instead).

get.summary:
Today (Dhaka): orders taken, waiting to book, on the road, delivered and returned, and today's
profit.

Real profit per Dhaka day and in total for a range (default: this month so far). Sales count
on the delivery day, returns on the return day. Unknown figures count 0 and are listed in
`missing`.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: First day (inclusive). <example>2026-11-01</example>

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Last day (inclusive), at most 366 days after `from`. <example>2026-11-30</example>

get.summary: The plan, and used / limit for this billing month (Dhaka calendar month). A null limit means unlimited.
Gets the shop profile and delivery charges.

put.summary: Replaces the shop profile and delivery charges (Owner or Manager).

get.summary: Lists everyone in the shop, owner included, oldest first.

post.summary: Invites a person by phone; they join the shop at their next OTP sign-in.

put.summary: Changes a staff member's role. Takes effect at their next token refresh (within 15 minutes).

delete.summary: Removes a staff member and ends their sessions. The owner cannot be removed.

oneOf.description: The courier to book with; omit to use the shop's default courier.

Where the courier delivers, in its own location IDs (couriers with `supportsLocations`,
from GET /api/couriers/{provider}/locations). Omit to book by address.

orderIds.description: Confirmed orders to book (at most Booking:MaxBatchSize, 100 by default); each succeeds or fails on its own.

oneOf.description: The courier to book with; omit to use the shop's default courier.

orderIds.description: Up to 100 order IDs; each succeeds or fails on its own.

examples: Customer asked to cancel on Messenger

CodAgeBucketDto.description: Unpaid cash that has been with the courier for this long (Dhaka days since delivery).

CodSummaryResponse.description: What every courier owes the shop, and the totals. Expected = collected + shortfall + outstanding.

credentials.description: The courier's fields (see `fields` in GET /api/couriers), e.g. `{ "apiKey": "..." }`. Stored encrypted, never returned.

oneOf.description: The courier holding the cash; null for delivered orders without a booked shipment.

expected.description: COD due on every delivered parcel (order total minus advance), in BDT.

collected.description: What payouts actually paid for settled parcels, in BDT.

shortfall.description: Settled parcels' due minus what was paid (positive = short-paid), in BDT.

shortPaidParcels.description: Settled parcels paid a different amount than due.

outstanding.description: Still with the courier (not paid out yet), in BDT.

oldestOutstandingDays.description: Age of the oldest unpaid parcel in days; null when nothing is owed.

outstandingByAge.description: Outstanding split by age: always four buckets, youngest first.

CourierCodDto.description: One courier's cash position. Expected = collected + outstanding.

CourierQuoteResponse.description: A courier's price for one order.

variantId.description: The catalogue variant; name, SKU, price and cost are copied from it.

phone.description: The buyer's mobile number; matches an existing customer or creates one.

deliveryAddress.description: Defaults to the customer's saved address.

isInsideDhaka.description: Picks the shop's inside or outside Dhaka delivery charge.

deliveryCharge.description: Overrides the shop's delivery charge (BDT), e.g. free delivery for a loyal buyer.

variants.description: At least one. A product without sizes or colours has one variant without them.

history.description: Order counts by outcome in this shop.

deliveredValue.description: Sum of the totals of delivered and COD-settled orders, in BDT.

risk.description: New, Safe, Watch or Risky, with every reason that applies (this shop's history only).

CustomerDetails.description: The customer page: details, track record and what they have paid for.

CustomerLookupRequest.description: The phone travels in the body, never the URL: URLs end up in proxy logs, browser history and Referer headers.

history.description: Order counts by outcome in this shop.

risk.description: New, Safe, Watch or Risky, with every reason that applies (this shop's history only).

CustomerLookupResponse.description: The customer, their track record with this shop and the risk badge it gives.

DestinationRequest.description: A courier's own location IDs: city and zone required, area optional.

phone.description: Bangladeshi mobile number, any common spelling.

examples: Customer asked to cancel on Messenger
note.description: Why, e.g. a cancellation reason; saved in the order's history.

collected.description: Cash collected for the parcel, in BDT.

match.description: Settled, AmountDiffers (settled; see shortfall), UnknownParcel, NotDelivered, AlreadyPaid or RepeatedInPayout.

orderId.description: The parcel's order when the consignment was found.

codDue.description: What the order was due, in BDT, when found.

shortfall.description: Due minus collected on a settled line (positive = short-paid); null when nothing was settled.

PayoutLineDto.description: One statement line and what matching decided.

consignmentId.description: The courier's consignment ID, as on the statement.

collected.description: Cash the courier collected for this parcel, in BDT.

deliveryFee.description: Delivery charge the courier deducted, in BDT.

codFee.description: Cash-handling (COD) fee the courier deducted, in BDT.

PayoutLineRequest.description: One parcel on the courier's payout statement.

reference.description: The courier's statement or transfer ID.

paidOn.description: The day the money arrived (Dhaka date).

collected.description: Sum of the lines' collected cash, in BDT.

deliveryFees.description: Sum of the lines' delivery charges, in BDT.

codFees.description: Sum of the lines' COD fees, in BDT.

statementNet.description: Collected minus delivery and COD fees, from the lines.

difference.description: NetAmount minus statementNet: negative = less arrived than the statement says.

settledParcels.description: Lines that settled an order (Settled or AmountDiffers).

mismatchedParcels.description: Lines that need a look: amount differs, or nothing settled.

PayoutSummaryDto.description: A recorded payout. NetAmount = statementNet + difference; a non-zero difference is money no line explains.

delivered.description: Parcels delivered (sales count on the delivery day).

sales.description: Order totals of delivered parcels: lines + delivery charge, advance included.

productCost.description: Cost price of the sold lines (lines without one count 0).

deliveryFees.description: The courier's delivery fees: from its payout when paid, else the booking quote.

returnCharges.description: The courier's charges for bringing returned parcels back.

codFees.description: The courier's cash-handling fees, known once a payout settles the parcel.

ProfitFiguresDto.description: Real profit = sales - productCost - deliveryFees - returnCharges - codFees (all BDT).

to.description: Last day of the range (Dhaka), inclusive.

days.description: Every day in the range, oldest first, including days with nothing.

missing.description: Figures that were unknown and counted as 0: when `missing.any`, profit may be overstated.

ProfitReportResponse.description: Profit per Dhaka day and in total.

returnCharge.description: What the courier charged to bring it back, in BDT. Optional; only staff who can see profit may send it.

note.description: Saved in the order's history, e.g. the box's condition.

ReceiveBackRequest.description: A returned parcel is back at the shop.

reference.description: The courier's statement or transfer ID. <example>PTH-PAY-20261124</example>

paidOn.description: The day the money arrived (Dhaka date). <example>2026-11-24</example>

netAmount.description: What arrived in the shop's account, in BDT. <example>4830.00</example>

RecordPayoutRequest.description: A payout as it arrived: the transfer and the statement lines it pays for.

RefreshTokenRequest.description: Leave string? RefreshTokenRequest.RefreshToken empty to use the cookie.

returnCharge.description: In BDT; replaces any earlier amount.

ReturnChargeRequest.description: The courier's charge for bringing a returned parcel back.

ShopResponse.description: The shop profile. Amounts are in string ShopResponse.Currency.

TodayResponse.description: The owner's home screen: today's pipeline and today's profit.

TokenDelivery.description: Where the refresh token goes. Browsers use the HttpOnly cookie; other clients ask for the body.

logoUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the logo image.

oneOf.description: Courier pre-selected when booking. Null for none.

UpdateShopRequest.description:
The editable shop profile. Only these fields bind from JSON: the id, tenant and creation
time can never be posted (no over-posting), because the entity is never bound.

sku.description: Stock-keeping unit; stored upper-case, unique among the shop's active variants.

costPrice.description: What the shop paid, BDT. Owner only; omit it to keep the current cost.
